installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# DepotDownloader Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

SRCDS_APPID=258550

## download and install DepotDownloader
## (no apt: the installer image's Debian mirrors are not reliable, so unzip is
##  provided by a static busybox binary when the image doesn't have it)
## Wings mounts /tmp in the install container as a small tmpfs (100 MB by default,
## "tmpfs_size" in the Wings config), so all temporary files go on the server disk.
WORKDIR=/mnt/server/.install-tmp
rm -rf "${WORKDIR}"
mkdir -p "${WORKDIR}" /mnt/server/depotdownloader
export TMPDIR="${WORKDIR}"
cd "${WORKDIR}"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o DepotDownloader.zip https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases/latest/download/DepotDownloader-linux-x64.zip || { echo "Failed to download DepotDownloader."; exit 1; }

if command -v unzip > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    UNZIP="unzip"
else
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "${WORKDIR}/busybox" https://busybox.net/downloads/binaries/1.35.0-x86_64-linux-musl/busybox || { echo "Failed to download busybox (needed for unzip)."; exit 1; }
    chmod +x "${WORKDIR}/busybox"
    UNZIP="${WORKDIR}/busybox unzip"
fi

${UNZIP} -o DepotDownloader.zip -d /mnt/server/depotdownloader > /dev/null || { echo "Failed to extract DepotDownloader."; exit 1; }
chmod +x /mnt/server/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader
DEPOTDOWNLOADER=/mnt/server/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader

# Keep ownership/HOME behaviour identical to the original script.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
# Avoid needing ICU libraries for the .NET runtime bundled with DepotDownloader
export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1

## Run DepotDownloader with its per-file output written to a log instead of the
## console. Wings throttles/drops console output when thousands of lines arrive,
## which hides errors. A short progress line is printed every 30 seconds instead.
## Success = exit code 0, or DepotDownloader reporting a finished download
## (it can abort on shutdown after the files are already fully written).
DD_LOG=/mnt/server/depotdownloader/last_run.log
run_depotdownloader_once() {
    "${DEPOTDOWNLOADER}" "$@" > "${DD_LOG}" 2>&1 &
    local PID=$!
    while kill -0 ${PID} 2> /dev/null; do
        sleep 30
        if kill -0 ${PID} 2> /dev/null; then
            echo "  still downloading... $(grep -E '^ *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+%' "${DD_LOG}" | tail -n 1 | sed -E 's/^ *([0-9.]+%).*/\1/')"
        fi
    done
    wait ${PID}
    DD_RC=$?
    if [ ${DD_RC} -eq 0 ] || grep -q "Total downloaded" "${DD_LOG}"; then
        tail -n 3 "${DD_LOG}"
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

## Retry wrapper: Steam regularly drops the connection right after handing out
## depot keys ("Lost connection to Steam ... A task was canceled."). A fresh run
## resumes where the last one stopped, so retrying with a growing delay fixes it.
## Usage: run_depotdownloader "<label>" <DepotDownloader args...>
DD_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5
run_depotdownloader() {
    local LABEL="$1"
    shift
    local ATTEMPT
    for ATTEMPT in $(seq 1 ${DD_MAX_ATTEMPTS}); do
        echo "Downloading ${LABEL}, attempt ${ATTEMPT}/${DD_MAX_ATTEMPTS}..."
        if run_depotdownloader_once "$@"; then
            return 0
        fi
        echo "  attempt failed (exit code ${DD_RC}): $(grep -v '^ *[0-9.]*%' "${DD_LOG}" | grep -v '^ *at ' | tail -n 1)"
        if [ ${ATTEMPT} -lt ${DD_MAX_ATTEMPTS} ]; then
            echo "  retrying in $((ATTEMPT * 15)) seconds..."
            sleep $((ATTEMPT * 15))
        fi
    done
    echo "${LABEL} failed after ${DD_MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts. Last lines of DepotDownloader's log:"
    tail -n 30 "${DD_LOG}"
    return 1
}

## install game using DepotDownloader
run_depotdownloader "Rust (app ${SRCDS_APPID})" -app ${SRCDS_APPID} -os linux -dir /mnt/server ${EXTRA_FLAGS} -validate || exit 1

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/RustDedicated ]; then
    echo "Download finished but RustDedicated is missing, install failed."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/RustDedicated

## set up steamclient libraries (pulled from the Steamworks SDK Redist, app 1007,
## since there is no steamcmd install to copy them from anymore)
printf '%s\n' "steamclient.so" "linux64/steamclient.so" > "${WORKDIR}/steamclient_files.txt"
run_depotdownloader "steamclient libraries (app 1007)" -app 1007 -os linux -dir "${WORKDIR}/steamworks_sdk" -filelist "${WORKDIR}/steamclient_files.txt" || { echo "Failed to download steamclient libraries."; exit 1; }

SDK32="${WORKDIR}/steamworks_sdk/steamclient.so"
SDK64="${WORKDIR}/steamworks_sdk/linux64/steamclient.so"
for LIB in "${SDK32}" "${SDK64}"; do
    if ! head -c 4 "${LIB}" 2> /dev/null | grep -q "ELF"; then
        echo "steamclient library ${LIB} is missing or corrupt."
        exit 1
    fi
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v "${SDK32}" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v "${SDK64}" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Boot-time updates: the Rust image's /entrypoint.sh runs ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh
## on every start (unless AUTO_UPDATE=0), before Oxide/Carbon are applied. Put a
## small script at that path that updates with DepotDownloader instead.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
cat > /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh << 'SHIM'
#!/bin/bash
# Installed by the Rust (DepotDownloader) egg. The Rust image's entrypoint calls
# this file to update the server on every boot; it uses DepotDownloader instead
# of steamcmd. Arguments passed by the entrypoint are ignored.
# A failed update never blocks the server from starting.

SERVER_DIR=/home/container
DD="${SERVER_DIR}/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader"
LOG="${SERVER_DIR}/depotdownloader/last_update.log"
export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1
export TMPDIR="${SERVER_DIR}/depotdownloader/tmp"
mkdir -p "${TMPDIR}"

if [ ! -x "${DD}" ]; then
    echo "[Update] DepotDownloader not found, skipping update (reinstall the server to fix)."
    exit 0
fi

echo "[Update] Checking for Rust updates with DepotDownloader..."
for ATTEMPT in 1 2 3; do
    timeout 1800 "${DD}" -app 258550 -os linux -dir "${SERVER_DIR}" ${EXTRA_FLAGS} > "${LOG}" 2>&1 &
    PID=$!
    while kill -0 ${PID} 2> /dev/null; do
        sleep 15
        if kill -0 ${PID} 2> /dev/null; then
            echo "[Update]   still updating... $(grep -E '^ *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+%' "${LOG}" | tail -n 1 | sed -E 's/^ *([0-9.]+%).*/\1/')"
        fi
    done
    wait ${PID}
    RC=$?
    if [ ${RC} -eq 0 ] || grep -q "Total downloaded" "${LOG}"; then
        echo "[Update] Done. $(grep 'Total downloaded' "${LOG}" | tail -n 1)"
        chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/RustDedicated" 2> /dev/null
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "[Update] Attempt ${ATTEMPT}/3 failed (exit code ${RC}): $(grep -v '^ *[0-9.]*%' "${LOG}" | grep -v '^ *at ' | tail -n 1)"
    if [ ${ATTEMPT} -lt 3 ]; then
        sleep $((ATTEMPT * 15))
    fi
done

echo "[Update] Update failed, starting with the existing server files. Restart to try again."
echo "[Update] Full log: depotdownloader/last_update.log"
exit 0
SHIM
chmod +x /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh

cd /mnt/server
rm -rf "${WORKDIR}"
echo "Installation complete."
